prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: SaaS服务合同新旧条款对照表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 6 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "条款号" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 62px
  col 2: header "原文" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 1563px
  col 3: header "修订后" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 3232px
  col 4: header "修订说明" · longest unbreakable word 35px · one-line width 1425px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"对照SaaS服务合同各条款的原文、修订后文本和修订说明，帮助读者理解变更。","reading":"读者先按条款号定位，再横向比较原文与修订后文本，最后查看修订说明；同一行应保持清晰的对应关系。手机宽度下，长条款会形成高行，较短单元格可利用同一行的高度换行。","groups":["原文与修订后是直接对照的一组，宽度应支持逐行比较；修订后内容更长，可按策略给予更多空间。","修订说明与两版条款同属一行，解释该条变更；条款号则承担定位作用。"],"keep_intact":["条款号，如第3.1条、第12.4条","数字、编号及合同中的专有名称应尽可能保持完整"],"may_wrap":["原文和修订后文本可按中文语义自然换行","修订说明可自然换行","表头可在必要时换行，但应保持易辨认"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [83, 100, 100, 76] · table 360×4287px · row heights [60, 687, 734, 943, 1013, 850] · column headers wrapped 1/4 · tallest cell 43 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [83, 72, 132, 72] · table 360×3683px · row heights [60, 827, 687, 687, 757, 664] · column headers wrapped 1/4 · tallest cell 35 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [83, 77, 87, 112] · table 360×5310px · row heights [36, 873, 897, 1176, 1245, 1083] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 53 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"条款号完整，原文与修订后等宽，两个版本的对照关系直观；没有词中断开。","problems":"修订后文本明显长于原文，多个行的高度由修订后列主导，原文和说明下方留下较大空白。修订说明表头换行，削弱了表头的整齐度。","cause":"原文和修订后各占100px，没有反映内容长度差异；修订说明仅76px，扣除边距后不足以容纳四字表头。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"把更多宽度给修订后，使长条款更容易连续阅读，行高和整表长度均有所下降；条款号完整，也没有词中断开。","problems":"原文和修订说明过窄，正文呈细长文字带，横向比较时阅读节奏不均；修订说明表头换行。部分行仍由狭窄的原文列撑高。","cause":"修订后占132px，而原文和修订说明各只有72px；两列扣除边距后仅剩51px文本宽度。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"四个表头均保持单行，修订说明比其他方案更易扫描；条款号完整，没有词中断开。","problems":"修订后列过窄，长条款被切成密集短行，整表和各数据行显著拉长；说明列下方出现大量空白，削弱同一行内的对照感。","cause":"修订后仅87px，却把112px分给内容较短的修订说明，宽度分配与内容负担不匹配。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"平衡对照","widths":[83,76,119,81],"change":"保留完整条款号和单行说明表头，以较多宽度容纳修订后文本；相较r0B，也稍微放宽原文和说明，改善横向比较的阅读节奏。"},{"name":"均衡双版本","widths":[83,87,108,81],"change":"进一步放宽原文，缩小两版条款的宽度差，检验更均衡的逐项对照是否值得增加修订后列的换行。"},{"name":"偏重修订后","widths":[83,65,130,81],"change":"在保持修订说明表头单行的前提下，接近r0B的修订后宽度；检验压窄原文后，长修订条款的收益是否足以抵消原文的阅读负担。"}]}
